definitions.gloss: Swiss roll; roll cake; jelly roll
definitions.explanation: A sponge cake spread with cream or filling, rolled into a cylindrical shape, and sliced into rounds for serving. A popular pastry in Japan, sold at bakeries, convenience stores, and department store food halls.

examples.japanese: ロールケーキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
⟦{生|なま}クリーム→生クリーム：15884_namakuriimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ロールケーキ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Fresh cream roll cake is popular.

examples.english: I brought a whole roll cake as a gift and it was very well received.

notes:
A wasei-eigo compound of "roll" + "cake." In English this is called a "Swiss roll" (British) or "jelly roll" (American), not a "roll cake."

USAGE:
ロールケーキ is one of the most popular Western-style pastries in Japan. Convenience store chains compete to offer premium versions, and famous patisseries are known for their signature rolls. Unlike many Western versions that use jam, Japanese ロールケーキ almost always features whipped cream (⟦{生|なま}クリーム→生クリーム：15884_namakuriimu⟧) as the primary filling. A whole uncut roll is counted with {本|ほん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{生|なま}クリーム→生クリーム：15884_namakuriimu⟧ロールケーキ: fresh cream roll cake
- ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧ロールケーキ: matcha roll cake
- ⟦フルーツ→フルーツ：11247_furuutsu⟧ロールケーキ: fruit roll cake
- ロールケーキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{分|わ}ける→切り分ける：11774_kiriwakeru⟧: to slice a roll cake into portions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ショートケーキ→ショートケーキ：27694_shootokeeki⟧: shortcake — in Japan, a triangular slice of sponge cake with strawberries and whipped cream
- ⟦シフォンケーキ→シフォンケーキ：27697_shifonkeeki⟧: chiffon cake — a light, airy cake, often ring-shaped
- バウムクーヘン: Baumkuchen — another popular rolled/layered cake in Japan
